text.p: Retailing giant Federated Department Stores Inc. Friday appointed a new
executive to replace Allen Questrom, the retiring chairman and chief executive who led the company out of bankruptcy.
Federated, at its annual shareholders meeting, introduced James Zimmerman as Questrom's replacement. Zimmerman, 52, has been president and chief operating officer of the company since 1988.

Questrom, 57, had been chairman and chief executive of Federated, which owns 410 Macy's and Bloomingdale's other big department stores in 36 states, since 1990. He was instrumental in leading Federated out of bankruptcy and in overseeing its acquisitions of both Macy's and Broadway stores.
"Having done what I set out to do," he said in January, when the company first announced his retirement, "the time now is right for me to leave."
Questrom's contract was to expire in February, 1998.
